primary_question: As of the run's UTC date, what is the latest stable Python release and its release date? Distinguish stable releases from prereleases, cite the official Python release/download page, and report uncertainty if official pages disagree or cannot be read.
intended_decision: State the latest stable Python version number, its release date, and an official python.org release or download page citation; note uncertainty if sources conflict or are unreadable.
exclusions: third-party download mirrors without primary python.org citation
